lesson.title: A serial line between offices
lesson.goal: DeskA reaches DeskB over a /30 serial line and a static route each way

step.text: Ping DeskB (192.168.2.10) from DeskA and read why it fails: nothing joins the two offices.
Run a serial cable between OfficeA and OfficeB. It lands on Serial0/0/0 at both ends.
The line gets the /30 network 10.0.0.0/30, which holds exactly two addresses. Give Serial0/0/0 the address 10.0.0.1/30 on OfficeA and 10.0.0.2/30 on OfficeB.
OfficeA still knows nothing about 192.168.2.0/24. Add a static route on OfficeA to 192.168.2.0/24 via 10.0.0.2.
Replies need a way back. On OfficeB add the route to 192.168.1.0/24 via 10.0.0.1.

check.label: OfficeA has the route to OfficeB's network
DeskA reaches DeskB over the serial line
